CustomField.description: Value for the Objective portion of the Account Plan Score
CustomField.formula:
IF(Default_Plan_Scoring__c, (IF( $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Score_Object__c, CASE(1, IF(Objectives_Count__c < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Count_BP_Low__c, 1, 0), 0, IF(Objectives_Count__c < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Count_BP_Mid__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Score_BP_Low__c, IF(Objectives_Count__c < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Count_BP_High__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Score_BP_Mid__c, $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Score_BP_High__c) * IF( $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Use_Time_Decay__c, CASE(1, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Objective_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_Low__c, 1, 0), 1, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Objective_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_Mid__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_Mult_Low__c, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Objective_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_High__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_Mult_Mid__c, $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_Mult_High__c), 1), 0)),
(IF( Objectives_Count__c > $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Threshold_Limit__c , $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Category_Point_Total__c, (Objectives_Count__c / $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Threshold_Limit__c)* $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Category_Point_Total__c)) * IF( $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Use_Time_Decay__c, CASE(1, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Objective_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_Low__c, 1, 0), 1, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Objective_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_Mid__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_Mult_Low__c, IF(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Objective_Max_LMD__c) < $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_High__c, 1, 0), $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_Mult_Mid__c, $CustomMetadata.PQ_AP_Score__mdt.Objective.Time_BP_Mult_High__c), 1))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: You can modify this by adjusting the custom metadata record corresponding to the Objective Values
CustomField.label: Objective Score
